obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Terms are evaluated once into bitmasks over runs; a conjunction is an AND, a behavioural class is a distinct mask, so 136 runs and ~1 000 hypotheses per goal cost 18.1 s with no model.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The grammar is over the reader's own rows, not over commands: order, multiplicity and identity are surface-neutral, so the same terms mean the same thing on a filesystem, a database and an archive.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Smallest-hypothesis-only fitting: measured to call a grammar identified while a larger consistent hypothesis rejects 32 accepted runs. State-level goals: empty by theorem. Guessing among survivors: costs a false accept, the accusation class.
